brief: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send these: What are the fest dates, and can you paste the list of events? For each event we need the day, start time, category (for example coding, robotics, gaming) and the room or place.; What is the venue address inside Northfield College of Engineering (building or ground name), and what WhatsApp number should students message? A Google Maps link to the venue is also welcome.; Who are the sponsors? Please give their names, and say whether you have logos to use or should we show names only.; When a student fills in the registration form, where should their details go.
questions_to_user.answer: Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.

validator_rejections.reason: work atom 1: check 2 grep-count targets 'id="hero"': only a section id or class name, never a charter fact, an email or a generic string (use facts-present for those)

validator_rejections.workflow: Nav, responsive styling and link check
validator_rejections.reason: a check or report on the site is Audit's job, not a workflow

done_when.criterion: The page shows the name Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, and the dates 14 to 16 February 2027.

A schedule section has three switchable day views (Day 1 14 Feb, Day 2 15 Feb, Day 3 16 Feb) listing each event on its correct day with its start and end time: Day 1 Code Sprint 10am-1pm, Line Follower 2pm-5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm-6:30pm; Day 2 Bug Hunt 11am-1pm, Poster Jam 2pm-4pm; Day 3 Drone Dash 10am-1pm, UI Duel 2pm-5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm-6:30pm.

An events section can be filtered by category (Coding, Robotics, Design, Talks) and shows each event with its fee: Code Sprint Rs 100, Bug Hunt Rs 50, Line Follower Rs 150, Drone Dash Rs 200, Poster Jam free, UI Duel Rs 100, AI in Daily Life free, Startup Stories free.

A registration form has required fields for name, email and college, plus an event dropdown listing all eight events; submitting it sends the details to spark2026@example.com and shows the student a success or error message.
A sponsors section lists Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs and Pixel Press as text names with no logos.
A venue section shows the address 'Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007' and a link that opens it in Google Maps.
A WhatsApp button links to wa.me/910000033333 (+91 00000 33333), and the email spark2026@example.com is shown as a contact.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
